---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  summarize(
    total_hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .by = playerID
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total_hr)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active (1994–2009)",
      "Other Era"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_hr, y = fct_reorder(name, total_hr))) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = steroid_era)) +
  labs(
    title = "Career Home Run Leaders",
    subtitle = "Top 15 players by career home runs",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Career Era",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  summarize(
    hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = yearID
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds Home Runs by Season",
    subtitle = "Season-level home run totals",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
